WITH button_driver AS (
  SELECT driverId 
  FROM main.drivers 
  WHERE LOWER(surname) = 'button' OR LOWER(driverRef) = 'button'
  LIMIT 1
),
race_2010 AS (
  SELECT raceId 
  FROM main.races 
  WHERE year = 2010
),
race_2009 AS (
  SELECT raceId 
  FROM main.races 
  WHERE year = 2009
),
points_2010 AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) as total_points
  FROM main.results r
  INNER JOIN button_driver b ON r.driverId = b.driverId
  INNER JOIN race_2010 r10 ON r.raceId = r10.raceId
),
points_2009 AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.points), 0) as total_points
  FROM main.results r
  INNER JOIN button_driver b ON r.driverId = b.driverId
  INNER JOIN race_2009 r09 ON r.raceId = r09.raceId
)
SELECT (SELECT total_points FROM points_2010) - (SELECT total_points FROM points_2009) AS points_difference
